nodes.description: Internal overridden _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) that applies limits, transfer delay, fees, auto LP burn, auto buyback and triggers swapBack.
Private swapBack() that swaps accumulated tokens for ETH and distributes ETH to dev, marketing and liquidity.
Private swapTokensForEth(uint256) that approves and swaps tokens for ETH via the DEX router.
Private addLiquidity(uint256,uint256) that adds token/ETH liquidity to the pair.
Internal autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() that transfers a percentage of LP tokens to dead and syncs the pair.
External onlyOwner manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens(uint256) that burns LP tokens and calls pair.sync().
External onlyOwner launch(uint256 _blockPenalty) that enables trading, creates the pair and adds initial liquidity.
External onlyOwner withdrawStuckETH() that sends the contract ETH balance to msg.sender before launch.
External onlyOwner buyBackTokens(uint256) that swaps ETH for tokens and sends them to the dead address.
External onlyOwner forceSwapBack() that forces a swapBack with the swapping guard.
Internal autoBuyBack(uint256) that performs an ETH-to-token buyback via the router.
External onlyOwner updateBuyFees() that sets buy-side fee parameters.
External onlyOwner updateSellFees() that sets sell-side fee parameters.
External onlyOwner setAutoBuyBackSettings() that configures the automatic buyback.
External onlyOwner setAutoLPBurnSettings() that configures the automatic LP burn.
External onlyOwner transferOwnership(address) that changes the contract owner.
Public onlyOwner excludeFromFees(address,bool) that toggles fee exclusion.
External onlyOwner updateMarketingWallet(address) that changes the marketing wallet.
External onlyOwner updateDevWallet(address) that changes the dev wallet.
Internal _createInitialSupply(address,uint256) that mints the initial supply to the given account.
Payable constructor that initializes supply, fees, wallets and exclusions.
Bool reentrancy guard flag used around swapBack and other swaps.
Address of the liquidity pair created at launch.
Block number at which trading was enabled, used for the launch penalty.
Flag enabling the automatic ETH buyback.
Timestamp of the last automatic buyback.
Timestamp of the last automatic LP burn.
Flag enabling automatic LP burning.
Address receiving marketing ETH from swaps.
Address receiving dev ETH from swaps.
Flag indicating that trading has been launched.
Flag controlling whether auto swapBack may run.
Flag enabling the anti-bot transfer delay limiting one transfer per block per address.
Flag enabling max transaction and max wallet limits.
Mapping of address to last transfer block used by the transfer delay mechanism.
msg.sender, the caller address, used in several functions and in withdrawStuckETH.
block.timestamp, used for fee/burn/buyback frequencies and launch times.
tx.origin, used as the key for the transfer delay mapping in _transfer.
Low-level .call{value:} sends of ETH to devWallet and marketingWallet inside swapBack.
External swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call to an arbitrary DEX router.
External pair.sync() call on the LP pair after burning LP tokens.
Low-level .call{value:} sending the whole ETH balance to msg.sender in withdrawStuckETH.
External swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call used for buybacks and in buyBackTokens.
External addLiquidityETH call to the DEX router inside launch.
from address parameter of _transfer.
to address parameter of _transfer.
amount uint256 parameter of _transfer.
fees local variable computed in _transfer from buy/sell/penalty rates.
contractTokenBalance local variable in _transfer used to decide on swapBack.
amountInWei ETH amount parameter of buyBackTokens and autoBuyBack.
percent parameter of manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
_blockPenalty parameter of launch used to configure the sniper penalty window.
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount parameter of addLiquidity.
newMarketingWallet parameter of updateMarketingWallet.

edges.reason: The from parameter flows into the _transfer logic that decides whether limits, delay and fees apply.
The to parameter flows into the _transfer logic for limit and fee determination.
The amount parameter drives all limit checks and fee computations in _transfer.
The local fees value is derived from amount times fee percentages and is deducted from amount.
The computed fees are subtracted from amount (amount -= fees) before the final transfer.
contractTokenBalance decides whether swapBack is triggered during a transfer.
The swapping guard read in _transfer prevents nested execution of swapBack and swap logic.
tradingActive gates whether non-excluded accounts may transfer tokens.
limitsInEffect gates the max transaction and max wallet checks in _transfer.
transferDelayEnabled gates the one-transfer-per-block anti-bot restriction.
_holderLastTransferBlock is read and written to enforce the transfer delay.
tx.origin is used as the mapping key for the transfer delay, allowing bypass or griefing by intermediary contracts.
block.timestamp controls LP burn and buyback triggering inside the transfer path.
block.timestamp is stored in lastLpBurnTime when the automatic LP burn executes.
block.timestamp is compared against manualBurnFrequency and stored in lastManualLpBurnTime.
block.timestamp is emitted in the OwnerForcedSwapBack event.
block.timestamp is stored in lastAutoBuyBackTime and used as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline and to seed lastLpBurnTime in launch.
msg.sender is the recipient of the contract ETH balance in withdrawStuckETH.
msg.sender receives the ETH in the low-level call performed by withdrawStuckETH.
devWallet is the destination of the ETH low-level call in swapBack.
marketingWallet is the destination of the ETH low-level call in swapBack.
lpPair balance is read to compute the amount of LP tokens to burn.
lpPair is cast to IDexPair and its sync() function is invoked.
lpBurnEnabled gates the automatic LP burn call from _transfer.
autoBuyBackEnabled gates the automatic buyback call from _transfer.
lastAutoBuyBackTime is compared against autoBuyBackFrequency to decide the buyback.
lastLpBurnTime is compared against lpBurnFrequency to decide the LP burn.
tradingActiveBlock is used by isPenaltyActive to apply the sniper penalty inside _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swapBack triggered inside _transfer.
amountInWei is the ETH amount passed to the router swap in buyBackTokens.
amountInWei supplies the value sent with the buyback swap call.
percent determines the amount of LP tokens burned in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
_blockPenalty configures blockPenalty used by isPenaltyActive.
tokenAmount is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount is forwarded as value to addLiquidityETH.
newMarketingWallet is assigned to the marketingWallet state variable by the owner.
autoBuyBack writes the current timestamp into lastAutoBuyBackTime.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes the current timestamp into lastLpBurnTime.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens also updates lastManualLpBurnTime and interacts with the pair.
_transfer sets the swapping guard to true before swapBack and false afterwards.
forceSwapBack sets the swapping guard around the swapBack call.
_transfer calls swapBack when the contract token balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on qualifying sells.
_transfer calls autoBuyBack on qualifying sells when ETH balance is sufficient.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to add the liquidity portion of ETH.
swapBack forwards ETH to dev and marketing wallets via low-level calls after swapping.
forceSwapBack invokes swapBack directly.
The constructor mints the initial supply by calling _createInitialSupply for two accounts.
launch calls dexRouter.addLiquidityETH with the contract balance to seed liquidity.
buyBackTokens performs an external ETH-to-token swap on the router.
autoBuyBack performs an external ETH-to-token swap on the router.
swapTokensForEth, reached from _transfer via swapBack, calls the router token-to-ETH swap.
pair.sync() is an external call on the LP pair executed inside the transfer path, allowing reentrancy into the token contract.
The low-level ETH calls to dev and marketing wallets hand control to arbitrary addresses before _transfer completes, enabling reentrancy.
The router ETH-to-token swap can call back into the token's transfer logic and re-enter _transfer.
The router token-to-ETH swap can call back into the token's transfer logic and re-enter _transfer.
The low-level call to msg.sender in withdrawStuckETH transfers control to the caller before state finalization.
The amount parameter is multiplied by fee percentages to compute the fees local variable.
launch requires trading to be inactive and then sets tradingActive to true.
launch enables swapEnabled along with trading activation.
The constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, marketing wallet, contract and dead address.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is only used inside _transfer to index exclusions and pair mappings.
The to parameter is only meaningful within the _transfer limit and fee logic.
The amount parameter is consumed entirely by the _transfer fee and limit computations.
The fees local variable is a temporary artifact of the _transfer fee arithmetic.
contractTokenBalance is the local quantity that decides entry into swapBack from _transfer.
amountInWei only parameterizes the external buyback swap performed by buyBackTokens/autoBuyBack.
percent only scales the LP burn amount in the manual burn function.
_blockPenalty is only used to set blockPenalty during launch.
tokenAmount is only the input to the token-to-ETH router swap.
ethAmount is only the ETH value forwarded to addLiquidityETH.
newMarketingWallet is only assigned to the marketingWallet state variable.
